summary: Constructor-style initializer for a UI list/texture manager object. Zero-initializes the whole struct via GlobalZeroInit_c2a0, allocates and initializes a 76-byte sub-object (sub_556220) stored at this+0x0, registers the object via sub_556260(1), allocates a count array of 136-byte stride scale-default elements with a leading count header, and fills the remaining fields: count at this+0x14, array pointer at this+0x18, zeroed fields at this+0x8/0xC/0x10/0x1C/0x20/0x24, and the constant flag 0x20000 at this+0x4. Returns the object pointer.

local_names.a2: element count for the allocated scale-default array
local_names.v6: allocated array base, with count header at v6[0] and elements from v6[1]
local_names.v7: array element pointer stored at this+0x18
local_names.v5: saved element count stored at this+0x14

operations.description: Zero-initialize the whole struct with GlobalZeroInit_c2a0(this).
Allocate a 76-byte sub-object via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, initialize it with sub_556220, and store the resulting pointer at this+0x0 (null when the allocation fails).
Register the object through sub_556260(1) after the sub-object is attached.
Allocate the element array with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper sized 136 * a2 + 4 bytes: a 4-byte count header plus a2 elements of 136-byte stride.
Store the element count a2 in the array header at v6[0] and point v7 at the first element slot v6 + 1.
When the count minus 1 is non-negative, iterate a2 times calling StructInitWithScaleDefaults on each element slot, advancing by 34 dwords (136 bytes) per element.
Clear the fields at this+0x8, this+0xC, this+0x10, this+0x1C, this+0x20 and this+0x24 to zero.
Store the element array pointer v7 at this+0x18 and the saved element count at this+0x14; v7 is the first element slot on success or null on allocation failure.
Set the constant flag 0x20000 at this+0x4.
Return the initialized object pointer this.

unresolved: The purpose of the 76-byte sub-object constructor sub_556220 (0x00556220) and the registration helper sub_556260 (0x00556260) are inferred from the surrounding init sequence only.
The meaning of the 0x20000 flag at this+0x4 and the element type of the 136-byte stride array are caller-contract details not documented in this function.
Element count is stored both in the array header (v6[0]) and at this+0x14; which one is authoritative for consumers is unknown here.
